scope: YHM2510 sensing, Case interfaces, and Mac right-temple recovery

conclusions.yhmAdcRegisters: No verified YHM2510 digital ADC result-register map or physical-unit scaling recovered.
conclusions.separateSensingPath: Native Case 0x0800CE34 selects each side through YHM registers then reads the STM32 ADC using 0x08002EDC; this is used for electrical presence/water protection.
conclusions.batteryVsHardware: Neither UART silence nor aggregate current establishes battery voltage or distinguishes battery undervoltage, PMIC fault, broken contact/path, corrupted application, or disabled secure recovery.
conclusions.recovery: Running-application OTA and boot-time application installation are recovered. Retail dead-temple secure wired recovery is not proven.

registers.meaning: Left policy output control: stock 0xAE idle / 0xAF charging
Right policy output control: stock 0xAE idle / 0xAF charging
Policy-dependent electrical sensing configuration; stock values 3, 7, 11
Sensing/routing configuration: 0x8B left / 0x8D right in water-protection test; 0x85 left / 0x87 right in presence test; 0x81 idle
Stock idle configuration 0x20; other contexts use different values

registers.namespace: Separate command-2 fuse/configuration read, not normal command-0x42 register reads

adc.sampling: STM32 ADC data register at *(handle)+0x40; handle 0x200008E4. Eight readings, drop highest/lowest, average six.
adc.policyCalculation: trimmed ADC sample * 1000 / adjustment byte; thresholds <80 and >120; presence threshold 620 raw counts.
adc.unitBoundary: These thresholds are not verified charging milliamps or battery millivolts.
adc.safeProbeBoundary: Switching the mux also changes power/sense configuration. Existing AA dump does not contain the ADC sample. No arbitrary register writes authorized by a guessed register map.
adc.dataRegister: STM32 ADC1 DR at 0x40012440; initialization puts 0x40012400 in handle 0x200008E4.
adc.policyMeaning: Native low-sense branch labels it water detection and disables 5V output. It must not be represented as low battery or calibrated low charging current.
